breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction by defining M(x) = P·L as a constant over the full span. The ground truth requires the correct varying moment M(x) = P·(L-x) for a cantilever with an end load. As a result, the Agent computes delta = P·L³/(E·I) ≈ 9.7826 mm instead of the correct Castigliano result of delta = P·L³/(3·E·I) ≈ 3.2609 mm. The inconsistency was not resolved.
